title: OceanEmbed Subsurface Temperature Climatology Schema
description: Climatological reference dataset computed strictly from training years (2015-04-01 to 2022-12-31).

temp_clim_mean.description: Day-of-year mean temperature array [366, 15, 101, 241] in °C computed over 2015-2022 training years.

temp_clim_std.description: Day-of-year standard deviation array [366, 15, 101, 241] in °C computed over 2015-2022 training years.

global_train_mean.description: Overall static time-mean temperature [15, 101, 241] in °C across the entire training period.

global_train_std.description: Overall static standard deviation [15, 101, 241] in °C across the entire training period.
